title: Transport of a module comparison through a scheme isomorphism
statement: Choose derived categories of scheme modules [def-pc-derived-category] and additive tensor pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $a:Y\to X$, $p:P\to X$ be scheme maps [def-pc-scheme], and $e:Y\cong P$ satisfy $e\gg p=a$. Supply any natural isomorphism $j:La^*\gg Re_*\cong Lp^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For $G\in X.\mathrm{Modules}$ let $c:La^*(G[0])\to(a^*G)[0]$ satisfy IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison [def-pc-derived-module-base-change-map]. There exist $d:Lp^*(G[0])\to(p^*G)[0]$ satisfying the same comparison predicate for $p,G$, and an isomorphism $m:Re_*((a^*G)[0])\cong(p^*G)[0]$, with $Re_*(c)\gg m=j_{G[0]}\gg d$.

source.place: Tags 08HY (adjoint description), 0D5S (pullback composition), 0D5T (direct-image composition), and 06YJ (left-derived counit)

proof.text: Pushforward along e is an exact equivalence inverse to pullback along e. Its localization is the recorded derived direct image, by the derived universal property. Underived tensor composition identifies e_*(a^*G) with p^*G. The equivalence commutes with the single functor, giving m.

Unpack hc as a left-derived counit epsilon. Postcompose with the equivalence e_* and with the tensor composition identification. Equivalences preserve the defining right Kan extension. Precompose with j.inv to obtain a witnessing left-derived counit for Lp^*. Evaluate at G[0] and compose with the single-complex identification to define d. Naturality and j.hom followed by j.inv = identity give the required equality. Any choice of j is absorbed in this counit.

proof_origin.place: Coordinate transport of the counit construction, with universal-property details supplied by R3
proof_origin.note: Complete argument in module docstring; edge cases: zero G, empty schemes, identity e. Neither flatness nor invertibility of beta is used.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_modulePullbackComparison_iso_transport
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (a : Y ⟶ Z), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).Additive]
    {X Y P : Scheme.{u}} (a : Y ⟶ X) (p : P ⟶ X) (e : Y ≅ P)
    (hp : e.hom ≫ p = a)
    (j : derivedPullback a ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage e.hom ≅ derivedPullback p)
    (G : X.Modules)
    (c : (derivedPullback a).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G) ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).obj G))
    (hc : IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison a G c) :
    let E := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G
    let N := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings P.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p).obj G)
    ∃ d : (derivedPullback p).obj E ⟶ N,
      IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison p G d ∧
      ∃ m : (schemeDerivedDirectImage e.hom).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).obj G)) ≅ N,
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage e.hom).map c ≫ m.hom = j.hom.app E ≫ d
